# Python Template Instructions

- Use the repository-owned `script/*` commands for bootstrap, test, lint, build, and acceptance work.
- Keep Python, uv, dependencies, GitHub Actions, and container inputs exactly pinned.
- Prefer the Python standard library and keep the dependency graph small.
- Preserve offline bootstrap and routine development paths through the committed wheel caches.
- Require focused tests for behavior changes and maintain 100% line, branch, and function coverage.
- Keep changes simple, public-safe, and free of machine-specific configuration.
